s: God gives days of life (to man under the sun)
q: all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.

s: the wise has attribute shining face (result of wisdom)
q: A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.

s: the wise knows time and procedure (through his wise heart)
q: his wise heart will know the time and procedure.

s: the wise fails to find out work under the sun (even if he thinks he can comprehend it)
q: Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.

s: wicked has fate not well (will not lengthen days)
q: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.

s: wicked lacks fear of God (reason for their fate)
q: because he doesn’t fear God.

s: wicked lacks deliverance by wickedness
q: neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.

s: those who fear God has fate better (better outcome than sinners)
q: it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.

s: the righteous is in hand of God
q: the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God

s: man does not know his time
q: For man also doesn’t know his time.

s: man has heart full of evil (sons of men)
q: the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live

s: man goes to the dead (after life)
q: after that they go to the dead

s: enjoyment of life is approved by God (eating bread and drinking wine with joy)
q: for God has already accepted your works

s: time and chance happens to man (all, regardless of strength, wisdom or skill)
q: but time and chance happen to them all

s: little city has few men
q: There was a little city, and few men within it

s: great king besieges little city (built great bulwarks against it)
q: a great king came against it, besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it

s: poor wise man delivers little city (by his wisdom)
q: a poor wise man was found in it, and he by his wisdom delivered the city

s: poor wise man is forgotten by man (no one remembered him)
q: yet no man remembered that same poor man

s: poor wise man has wisdom despised (his words are not heard)
q: Nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

s: wisdom is better than strength
q: Wisdom is better than strength.

s: the Preacher observes wisdom under the sun (it seemed great to him)
q: I have also seen wisdom under the sun in this way, and it seemed great to me.

s: wisdom is better than weapons of war
q: Wisdom is better than weapons of war

s: the living has hope
q: For to him who is joined with all the living there is hope

s: the living knows they will die
q: For the living know that they will die

s: the dead knows nothing
q: the dead don’t know anything

s: the dead has no reward
q: neither do they have any more a reward

s: the dead has memory forgotten
q: for their memory is forgotten

s: the dead has no portion (in anything done under the sun)
q: neither do they any longer have a portion forever in anything that is done under the sun

s: the wise has heart at right hand
q: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand

s: king brings woe to land when is a child (land suffers when its king is a child)
q: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

s: king brings happiness to land when is son of nobles (land is happy when its king is the son of nobles)
q: Happy are you, land, when your king is the son of nobles, and your princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

s: king must not be cursed (not even in thoughts)
q: Don’t curse the king, no, not in your thoughts

s: fool has heart at left hand
q: a fool’s heart at his left

s: fool lacks understanding (when walking by the way)
q: when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool

s: the wise speaks gracious words
q: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious

s: fool is swallowed by his own lips
q: a fool is swallowed by his own lips

s: fool speaks foolishness and mischievous madness (beginning and end of his talk)
q: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness; and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

s: fool multiplies words
q: A fool also multiplies words.
